## Hardware gates

- [ ] No hardware action was performed without separate explicit authorization.
- [ ] Allowlisted artifact/rollback hashes and guarded-file preservation verified privately.
- [ ] At least 30 uninterrupted stable minutes with fresh-only metadata/link metrics.
- [ ] Separately coordinated power/reconnect and physical screens/buttons/HOME accepted.
- [ ] Explicit OS/source/helper/runtime/device matrix; unsupported/not-tested fields labeled.
- [ ] Original-versus-candidate conditions and stop reasons are unambiguous.
